before.exam_tip_html: Be specific in 6-mark answers about UK trade. Examiners reward named partners (USA, Germany, Netherlands), named goods (Scotch, cars, pharmaceuticals) and current statistics (40% of exports to EU, 46% of food imported). For 8-mark evaluations, weigh the benefits of being globally connected (markets, soft power) against the vulnerabilities (supply chain shocks, energy dependence) before reaching a justified conclusion.
